title: fix: dashboard charts empty due to Zod stripping widget inline data
body:
Dashboard chart and table widgets render with zero data. The `@objectstack/spec` `DashboardWidgetSchema` Zod schema has no `data` field, so `defineStack()` validation silently strips `data` from widget definitions. The `options` field (`z.unknown().optional()`) preserves arbitrary data through validation.

### Changes

- **`DashboardRenderer`** — Extract widget data from `options.data` as fallback when `widget.data` is absent (backward-compatible):

```ts
// Before: only checked widget.data (stripped by Zod)
const dataItems = Array.isArray(widget.data) ? widget.data : widget.data?.items || [];

// After: falls back to options.data
const widgetData = widget.data || options.data;
const dataItems = Array.isArray(widgetData) ? widgetData : widgetData?.items || [];
```

- **Example configs** (crm, kitchen-sink, todo) — Moved `data` into `options` where it survives Zod validation, removed `@ts-ignore` annotations
- **Tests** — 5 new tests covering data extraction from `options.data.items`, backward compat, table data, donut charts, and empty fallback
